died.name: John II Komnenos
died.cause: The Byzantine Emperor cut himself with a poisoned arrow during a boar hunt, subsequently dying from sepsis.

died.name: Frederick Denison Maurice
died.last_words: The knowledge of the love of God-the blessing of God Almighty, the Father, the Son and the Holy Ghost be amongst you-amongst us-and remain with us forever.

died.name: Charles I of Austria
died.last_words: Thy Holy Will be done. Jesus, Jesus, come! Yes, yes. My Jesus as Thou willst it, Jesus.

died.name: Marvin Gaye
died.cause: moments before being shot to death by his father
died.last_words: Mother, I'm going to get my things and get out of this house. Father hates me and I'm never coming back.

born.name: Charles de Saint-Évremond

born.last_words: With all my heart: I would fain be reconciled to my stomach, which no longer performs its usual functions.

born.name: Billy Whelan
